verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe telephony bots being invoked by carrier webhooks including 'Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel, or your SIP provider,' and highlight 'Any Transport: WebRTC, SIP, PSTN' plus a working CLI example (`python bot.py -t twilio -x ...ngrok.io`), showing genuine carrier/SIP flexibility rather than lock-in to one bundled provider. Missing for 10: concrete walkthrough of raw SIP trunk/PBX configuration (vs. just carrier webhooks), and independent/hands-on confirmation of a non-Twilio/Telnyx SIP trunk actually working in production.
